about.title: About
about.description: A modern, local-first visual database modeler tailored for PostgreSQL. Qube Modeler seamlessly bridges the gap between entity-relationship design and state-based Flyway migrations, keeping your entire database history in a single, Git-friendly project file.
about.projectFormatDescription: Local-first project files designed to be versioned with Git.
